whyFails.title: Why compliance training fails in real life
whyFails.narrative: Most compliance training becomes outdated the moment regulations change. Teams click through content to complete requirements, auditors demand evidence and version history, and global organizations struggle with multilingual delivery. The result: checkbox training that protects no one.

scorm.question: Does LearnPack export to SCORM for compliance tracking?
scorm.answer: Yes. Export packages to SCORM 1.2/2004 and deliver through your LMS.

certified.question: Is LearnPack certified for ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, or FedRAMP?
certified.answer: LearnPack is designed to fit regulated environments through portability and deployment control. Certification depends on the infrastructure and organization running the deployment.

updates.question: How do updates work when regulations change?
updates.answer: You can regenerate or refine content quickly, publish the new version, and keep training consistent across teams.
